tools.name: verificar_plantao
tools.description: Checks whether Doutor Chamada's on-call doctors are seeing patients right now (by the service hours, in Brasília time) and, if closed, when it reopens. Use when someone asks if there is a doctor available now or what the hours are. Takes no input.

tools.name: listar_opcoes_de_consulta
tools.description: Lists the consultation options (adult general practitioner, child or teenager, sports fitness, public-exam physical test, foreigner without CPF), who each is for, the price and the website link to start. Use when someone asks how much a consultation costs or which option fits them. Takes no input.

tools.name: iniciar_consulta
tools.description: Returns the website link to start a video consultation with Doutor Chamada for the chosen option, with the step-by-step (sign up and pay on the website, then wait for the doctor on video), the current on-call status and the emergency notice.
